report:
Reviewed the complete deterministic_trace claim, the ordinary sage_host::trace implementation association (including the complete trace.rs file), and the sole associated test, sage_meta::todo::crates_sage_inspector_inspection_deterministic_trace. Requirements are: a deterministic checked projection; retention of dynamic parentage and dispositions; canonical sorting only for explicitly unordered siblings; and closed or required/forbidden pattern assertions that avoid scheduler-order and raw-ID semantics.

Source inspection: snapshot_trace builds the dynamic tree and recursively replaces Unmapped ingredient debug payloads with operation names before normalizing unordered children again. query_operation strips arguments at the first parenthesis, so allocation-dependent query arguments do not become snapshot identity. Semantic keys remain unchanged. build_dynamic_trace uses a stack and attach_trace_node to retain nesting, carries phase/source/operation, maps all four Salsa dispositions (executed, validated, reused, cancelled), retains observations on leaves, and leaves explicit observed spans as observed. The normalization walk modifies only unmapped keys and permitted child ordering; it does not flatten parentage or replace dispositions. normalize_unordered_children returns immediately for Sequential and sorts only Unordered children by serialized complete TraceNode values. Recursion precedes the snapshot sorting, so the final ordering uses normalized child subtrees rather than raw Salsa arguments. Sequential child order and root order are preserved, rather than being globally sorted. The captured protocol definitions establish the serialized fields, stable enum representations, and distinction between Semantic/Unmapped and Sequential/Unordered. Malformed exit events are represented as recorder-error nodes and unfinished spans as Observed; the projection does not invent completion dispositions.

Test adequacy remains explicitly deferred. The only associated test is a TODO function with no executable assertions. It therefore verifies none of the above requirements and would not detect lost parentage, disposition changes, sorting a sequential group, raw-ID dependence, or a forbidden fallback. Its documented prerequisite is to associate and review the complete producer-authored sequential/unordered, cold/warm/edit, and forbidden-fallback evidence, including poll-scoped async spans that protect parentage and raw debug payload availability on failure. This is a justified evidence-integration deferral, not an assertion that those scenarios have been verified. Closed-set versus extensible required/forbidden matching and scheduler-independent assertion usage are included in that outstanding checked-projection evidence; they are not established by the pure projection function or this empty test. The ordinary implementation demonstrates the projection mechanism while the TODO test status must remain visible until meaningful assertions are associated and reviewed. No N/A entries exist.

Executed cargo meta review start with the saved coordinator instructions and cargo meta review read for the review policy, Rust skill, and protocol declarations. This is source review; no behavioral tests were run and no passing placeholder is offered as functional evidence. No source edits were made. All additional source dependencies used in this assessment were captured. No edits are requested for accepting the current explicitly deferred test status.
